text: Masco Corporation's proxy statement for its 2026 annual meeting lists three beneficial owners of more than five percent of its common stock, as of 31 December 2025: The Vanguard Group (12.8%), BlackRock, Inc. (7.4%) and Harris Associates LP (5.5%).
short: Masco's holders above 5% are Vanguard (12.8%), BlackRock (7.4%) and Harris Associates (5.5%).

source.name: Masco Corporation: Proxy Statement for the 2026 Annual Meeting (DEF 14A)
source.quote: all persons whom we know to be beneficial owners of more than five percent of our common stock
